title: Analytical Procedures (Related Substances IM1)[Purity][CP-6]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (Related Substances IM1)[Purity][CP-6].

action.title: Column
action.description: Silica C18 3,5 µm 250x4.6 mm or equivalent

action.title: Test solution
action.description: Approximately 1.0 mg/ml of sample to be examined in diluent (Acetonitrile:/ pH 5.0 Phosphate Buffer (1:4))

action.title: Reference solution
action.description: Approximately 0.001 mg/ml of CP-6 standard in diluent.

action.title: System Suitability Criteria
action.description: Resolution: between the peaks of CP-6 and CP-4 is not less than 1.5. Reproducibility:RSD between peak areas of replicate injections (six injections) of CP-6 is not more than 10%.

action.title: Calculation
action.description: (IWP*PR*C)/(IWR*PP*50#)*RF=by - and degradation product (%)    The specified and unspecified degradation products are calculated against CP-6 in the reference solution with the corresponding Response correction factor (RF). IWP =  integration value of the by-product or degradation product in the test solution IWR =  integration value of the by-product or degradation product in the reference solution PR =    initial concentration of the reference substance [mg/mL] PP =    initial concentration of the substance [mg/mL] C =     content of the reference substance, in % 50#      exemplary dilution factor
